Cấu tạo và nguyên lý hoạt động của cần g.en: Structures and principles of digital levers are made of hard plastic and used electromagnetic sensors to control the opening of digital oil valves. So if the driver operates the car properly, just use a small force the size of the fingers to move the forward, back or back to zero. As the driver operates incorrectly or uses the force of the whole arm to push forward or to grab the pull back for the reverse number, this plastic hug will break and cause damage.
Cấu tạo và nguyên lý hoạt động của cần g.zh: 数字杠杆的结构和原理由硬塑料和用过的电磁传感器所制成来控制数字石油阀的开口. 所以,如果驾驶员正常地操作汽车,只需用手指大小的一小股力将前行,后行或后行移动到0. 由于驾驶员操作不正确,或用全臂的力向前推或抓住后拉取倒数,这种塑料拥抱会破裂并造成损害.

Sau một thời gian sử dụng hệ thống phanh.en: After a period of the use of the lifter car's brakes is gradually worn out, the winnings when worn out will be eaten to the metal. The phenomenon is that when you step on the brakes, the brakes will feel deep, win hard to eat, or win normally, but produce the sound of the safe, the sound of the buzz. When this occurs, the driver must immediately stop the car and report to the provider for the examination, repair, and remedy of the incident. If this continues to happen, it will be very serious.
Sau một thời gian sử dụng hệ thống phanh.zh: 在一段时间使用升力车的制动装置逐渐磨损后,磨损时的胜负会被食用到金属上. 现象是,踩到刹车时,刹车会感觉很深,很难进食,或者正常地获胜,但会产生保险箱的声音,嗡嗡声. 发生这种情况时,驾驶员必须立即停车,并向供货商报告检查,修理,并对事故进行补救. 如果这种情况继续下去,将是非常严重的。
